verdict.rationale: Community evidence says Ollama has moved to a native MLX backend on Apple Silicon, replacing its earlier llama.cpp-based path, which should improve memory handling (ollama-comm-1). A hands-on M4 Pro benchmark shows 30 tok/s rising to 66–84 tok/s with nvfp4/int4 formats via `ollama run` (ollama-comm-3). An older user report of very slow Mistral inference on a MacBook Pro (ollama-comm-10) is a single anecdote that predates the MLX change, so it tempers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Apple Silicon/Metal/MLX acceleration, explicit evidence of native ARM builds and Metal GPU offload, and broader independent benchmarks.
